name: WorkerRegistry

methods.name: create
methods.desc: Initialize the contract. Sets sender as admin.

methods.name: add_worker
methods.desc: Admin adds a worker with personal details. Rating 10-50 (1.0-5.0 stars).

methods.name: increment_earnings
methods.desc: Increment worker's earnings and task count after payment. Admin only.

methods.name: apply_worker
methods.desc:
Worker self-registers by submitting an application to a specific platform.
Box key: app_ + worker(32) = 36 bytes. Box data: platform(32) + name(32) + phone(16) + upi_id(32) + applied_at(8) = 120 bytes. A worker can have one pending application at a time.

methods.name: approve_application
methods.desc:
Admin approves a pending application — creates the worker record and deletes the application.
Verifies the application's platform field matches Txn.sender (the admin).

methods.name: reject_application
methods.desc:
Admin rejects a pending application — deletes the application box.
Verifies the application's platform field matches Txn.sender.

methods.name: get_application
methods.desc:
Read a pending application. Returns 120 bytes raw.
Data layout: platform(32) + name(32) + phone(16) + upi_id(32) + applied_at(8).

methods.name: get_worker_info
methods.desc: Read worker info from box storage. Returns 120 bytes raw.

desc: Registry for gig workers with personal details, ratings, and earnings tracking.
